description.narrative: Evolution Data Centres (EDC or the Sponsor) is a hyperscale-oriented data center platform with a focus on underserved high-growth markets in Southeast Asia. EDC plans to develop, construct and put into service a 52MW data center located in Bangkok, Thailand (the Project). IFC proposes to support the Project by providing a loan of up toc. US$[150]million.

The Project is expected to increase access to data hosting services for businesses with the potential to grow digital services availability for individuals and enhance productivity growth for business. Beyond the Project, this investment could improve the competitiveness of Thailand's data-hosting market resulting in reduction of the supply gap.
